node.text: Sample BXP-001 · Search the web and use reliable sources. Find Bengaluru's weather forecast for the next three days. Show the date, high and low temperature in Celsius, and rain probability in a table, followed by two planning tips. Return only the answer in Markdown with source citations. Keep the complete answer within approximately 100-500 tokens; aim for 150-220 words including headings and citations. Avoid a generic introduction and follow-up offers. If requested current data is unavailable, say so briefly.

<a2ui> root=Column([a,b,c,d],"md") a=Table(columns=[{date:"Date",high:"High (°C)",low:"Low (°C)",rain:"probability"}],statePath="/forecast_data_data",domain="weather",preferredPresentation="cards") b=Text("AccuWeather’s Bengaluru forecast shows cloudy or sunny-interval conditions through the next three days with the highest rain chance on Wednesday and continued shower/thunder/storm potential on Thursday and Friday.","body") c=Text("Carry an umbrella or light rain jacket, especially for afternoon and evening plans.","body") d=Text("Plan outdoor activities earlier in the day, when conditions are likely to stay drier and slightly cooler.","3") </a2ui>
